excerpt.zh: 我们向帝国屈服，我们别无选择了……
excerpt.en: We yield to the Imperium. You have left us little choice...

texts.zh: 我们向帝国屈服，我们别无选择了……
texts.en: We yield to the Imperium. You have left us little choice...

texts.zh: 只有愚者才会试图挑战星海帝国的意志。我们投降。
texts.en: Only a fool would stand up to the might of the Galactic Imperium. We surrender.

texts.zh: 我们……我们宣誓向[Root.GetRulerTitle]效忠，并保证作为忠诚的帝国子民服务星海帝国。
texts.en: We... we swear fealty to the [Root.GetRulerTitle], and pledge to serve the Galactic Imperium as loyal Imperial citizens.
We shall submit to the authority of the [Root.GetRulerTitle].
